competency_fulfillment.rationale: Four of eight samples involve no fraction at all: seed 44 ("Find the missing number: 62, 63, 64, 65, ___"), seed 45, seed 50, and seed 110 ("Arrange these numbers from largest to smallest: 59, 61, 62, 60") are whole-number sequencing, number-line reading, and ordering tasks, not counting halves or quarters.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: No sample asks the student to count a number of half or quarter units toward a whole; the fraction-related items (seeds 42, 43, 46, 55) are single-fraction identification or shading reused from a different node, and 'quarters' never appears as a counted unit.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: In isolation the sentences are readable for Grade 1 Q4, e.g. "What number comes next when counting: 44, 45, 46, 47, ___?", though several are off-topic as noted above.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: Half the samples drift entirely off the fraction axis into whole-number skip-counting ("Find the missing number: 62, 63, 64, 65, ___") and ordering ("Arrange these numbers from largest to smallest: 59, 61, 62, 60"), sharing no content connection with counting halves and quarters.

competency_alignment.rationale: Seeds 44, 45, 50, and 110 vary along an unrelated axis (whole-number sequencing, number-line reading, and ordering as in "Arrange these numbers from largest to smallest: 59, 61, 62, 60") instead of building the fraction-counting competency this node names.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Only the 1/2 fraction appears anywhere in the packet; despite the competency explicitly naming 'quarters', no 1/4 counting item is present, and the off-topic whole numbers (44-77, 59-65) bear no relation to a fraction scale.
